q: What looks unusual in the last 14 days?
answer:
Most unusual: paid activity and traffic jumped sharply in the first half of October, with ad spend and product-level ad spend up ~140–195% and sessions nearly doubling — net sales (order/P&L basis) rose too, but P&L net sales shows an anomalous swing. 

- Product ad spend (allocated): ₹502,485 (2026-10-01..10-13), +195.0% vs prior 13 days (was ₹170,619).  
- Ad spend (platform-level): ₹708,883 (2026-10-01..10-13), +141.0% vs prior 13 days (was ₹293,571).  
- Sessions: 53,780, +96.0% vs prior 13 days (27,385). This matches the ad spend rise.  
- Net sales (P&L basis): ₹1,010,822, +75.0% vs prior 13 days (₹576,251).  
- P&L net sales (books / event-date): ₹906,860, a large negative-style swing vs the prior 13 days (prior = -₹503,974) — this is an anomalous sign change the data flagged and needs checking in the P&L feeds.

Worth checking: run a diagnosis on Ad spend (to see which campaigns/platforms increased) and on the P&L net sales anomaly (to confirm returns/cancellations or a bookkeeping posting caused the negative prior period).
